description: Executes a documented steamwebapi GET endpoint with the caller API key from the MCP Authorization or X-Api-Key header. Refuses POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE plus Proxy, Steam Guard and Tradeoffer endpoints.

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum upstream response bytes read into the tool result. Oversized JSON is omitted with guidance to request a smaller response.

parameters.description: Query and path parameters for the endpoint. Do not include `key`; pass your API key via the MCP Authorization or X-Api-Key header.

path.description: Documented OpenAPI GET path, e.g. "/steam/api/item" or "/market/{market}/prices".

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for the upstream API request and response body in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

name: call_readonly_endpoint
title: Call read-only steamwebapi endpoint
